task_summary: The customer reports that their kitchen knife set from order ORD-6023 was damaged during shipping. The proper resolution is to follow the shipping-damage protocol: review the return and shipping policies, refund the item to the original payment method, provide a return label, and apply the fragile item goodwill credit if applicable.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.

opening_message: My kitchen knife set from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged; the package was crushed.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You received a kitchen knife set from order ORD-6023 that was damaged in transit. You want a refund to the original payment method. If the item is classified as fragile, inquire about a separate fragile-item goodwill credit.
known_info: You purchased a kitchen knife set in order ORD-6023.
The item arrived with crushed packaging and damage.
unknown_info: You do not know the internal item ID unless the agent provides it.
task_rules: Keep the issue focused solely on shipping damage; do not request a changed-mind return, cancellation, warranty claim, or exchange.
After a valid damaged-in-transit return preview, confirm the resolution. If the item is fragile, expect the separate goodwill credit to be included.
